site_area_sqm.formula: unary union of SITE_BOUNDARY features in EPSG:4548
site_area_sqm.note_zh: 依据临时粗略边界复算，official 边界发布后必须重算
site_area_sqm.note_en: recalculated from the provisional boundary; must be recomputed when official geometry arrives

green_space_area_sqm.formula: unary union of GREEN_SPACE features in EPSG:4548
green_space_area_sqm.note_zh: 绿地为概念方案形态，非现状/批复绿地；官方绿地数据发布后必须重算
green_space_area_sqm.note_en: green-space shape is a concept proposal, not existing/approved green land; must be recomputed when official data arrives

public_space_area_sqm.formula: unary union of PUBLIC_SPACE features in EPSG:4548
public_space_area_sqm.note_zh: 公共空间多边形要素在 EPSG:4548 下按并集复算；该值为概念方案几何面积，非现状或批复公共空间面积，官方完整面数据发布后必须整体重算
public_space_area_sqm.note_en: public-space polygon features are unioned and recomputed in EPSG:4548; this is a conceptual-geometry area, not an existing or approved public-space area, and must be recomputed when complete official polygon data arrives

green_ratio.formula: green_space area / site area in EPSG:4548
green_ratio.note_zh: 绿地率为概念方案比值，非现状绿地率；官方绿地数据发布后必须重算
green_ratio.note_en: green ratio is a concept-proposal ratio, not the existing green ratio; must be recomputed when official data arrives

public_space_ratio.formula: public_space area / site area in EPSG:4548
public_space_ratio.note_zh: 公共空间多边形要素在 EPSG:4548 下按并集复算；该值为概念方案几何面积，非现状或批复公共空间面积，官方完整面数据发布后必须整体重算
public_space_ratio.note_en: public-space polygon features are unioned and recomputed in EPSG:4548; this is a conceptual-geometry area, not an existing or approved public-space area, and must be recomputed when complete official polygon data arrives

building_footprint_area_sqm.formula: unary union of buildings in EPSG:4548
building_footprint_area_sqm.note_zh: 建筑轮廓为概念体块，无既有建筑测绘；拆改留须以官方调查为准
building_footprint_area_sqm.note_en: footprints are concept massing with no existing-building survey; retain/renovate/demolish must await an official survey

road_length_m.formula: sum of projected road feature lengths in EPSG:4548
road_length_m.note_zh: 路段为概念路网，长度按投影几何要素长度累加，非现状道路长度
road_length_m.note_en: concept road network; projected segment lengths summed, not the existing road length

key_area_beijing_ai_origin_community_are.formula: area of KEY_AREA beijing_ai_origin_community in EPSG:4548

key_area_dazhongsi_ai_industry_cluster_a.formula: area of KEY_AREA dazhongsi_ai_industry_cluster in EPSG:4548

key_area_zhongzhiyuan_ai_acceleration_ar.formula: area of KEY_AREA zhongzhiyuan_ai_acceleration_area in EPSG:4548

ai_innovation_index.formula: 100 × mean(reproducible_experiment_score, cross_area_validation_score, public_governance_record_score, adoption_output_score), with each component normalized to 0–1
ai_innovation_index.proposed_target_horizon: 2030 conceptual scenario; reset after launch baseline
ai_innovation_index.measurement_frequency: 季度测量、年度独立复核 / quarterly with annual independent review
ai_innovation_index.data_owner: 拟议带区指标托管方，待确认 / proposed belt indicator steward, pending confirmation (A-DATA-001)
ai_innovation_index.status_wording: 基线待补齐；70/100为概念情景目标，不是批准指标或绩效承诺。
ai_innovation_index.reason: 锁定输入没有可复算的带区实验、跨区验证、治理记录和采纳成果联合台账。

ai_talent_density.formula: annual active AI research, engineering, governance, and creative participants / annual active work-and-learning participants in the belt
ai_talent_density.proposed_target_horizon: 2030 conceptual scenario; reset after launch baseline
ai_talent_density.measurement_frequency: 半年测量、年度审计 / semiannual with annual audit
ai_talent_density.data_owner: 拟议带区指标托管方，待确认 / proposed belt indicator steward, pending confirmation (A-DATA-001)
ai_talent_density.status_wording: 基线未知；目标参考首尔AI人才枢纽与Mila研究院的人才培养机制作概念外推（机制级参考，非数值移植），proposed/pending confirmation。
ai_talent_density.reason: 锁定输入没有带区统一的人才口径、活动去重名册和就业学习分母。

ai_output_scale.formula: count of distinct outputs per year passing reproducibility, risk review, and cross-area validation gates
ai_output_scale.proposed_target_horizon: 2030 annual conceptual scenario; reset after launch baseline
ai_output_scale.measurement_frequency: 季度登记、年度去重 / quarterly registration with annual deduplication
ai_output_scale.data_owner: 拟议带区指标托管方，待确认 / proposed belt indicator steward, pending confirmation (A-DATA-001)
ai_output_scale.status_wording: 基线待补齐；每年50项为概念情景目标，仅统计通过三类闸门的成果。
ai_output_scale.reason: 锁定输入没有按统一闸门登记的年度AI成果清单。

ecosystem_conversion_rate.formula: qualified scenarios entering limited procurement, public-service pilot, or sustained open-source maintenance / scenarios completing controlled tests in the same annual cohort
ecosystem_conversion_rate.proposed_target_horizon: 2030 annual cohort conceptual scenario; reset after launch baseline
ecosystem_conversion_rate.measurement_frequency: 年度同批次测量 / annual cohort measurement
ecosystem_conversion_rate.data_owner: 拟议带区指标托管方，待确认 / proposed belt indicator steward, pending confirmation (A-DATA-001)
ecosystem_conversion_rate.status_wording: 基线未知；目标参考Station F精选初创的筛选机制与Vector研究院的研究-应用转化加速功能作概念外推（机制级参考，非数值移植），proposed/pending confirmation。
ecosystem_conversion_rate.reason: 锁定输入没有同批次受控测试与采购、服务试点或持续维护的关联台账。
